loading_tip.java_reforged.new_dlc: New Downloadable Content is available! Access it from the Minecraft Store button on the Main Menu.
loading_tip.java_reforged.skin_packs: You can change the look of your character with a Skin Pack from the Minecraft Store. Select 'Minecraft Store' on the Main Menu to see what's available.
loading_tip.java_reforged.0: If you play this game in High Definition mode, you can have up to four players in split-screen on the same console!
loading_tip.java_reforged.1: Connect extra controllers to your console and press START on them to join a game at any point.
loading_tip.java_reforged.2: Alter the gamma settings to make the game brighter or darker.
loading_tip.java_reforged.3: If you set the game difficulty to Peaceful, your health will automatically regenerate, and no monsters will come out at night!
loading_tip.java_reforged.4: Feed a bone to a wolf to tame it. You can then make it sit or follow you.
loading_tip.java_reforged.5: You can drop items when in the Inventory menu by moving the cursor off the menu and pressing${java_reforged::controls/BUTTON_DOWN}
loading_tip.java_reforged.6: Sleeping in a bed at night will fast forward the game to dawn, but all players in a multiplayer game need to sleep in beds at the same time.
loading_tip.java_reforged.7: Harvest pork chops from pigs, and cook and eat them to regain health.
loading_tip.java_reforged.8: Harvest leather from cows, and use it to make armor.
loading_tip.java_reforged.9: If you have an empty bucket, you can fill it with milk from a cow, or water, or lava!
loading_tip.java_reforged.10: Use a hoe to prepare areas of ground for planting.
loading_tip.java_reforged.11: Spiders won't attack you during the day - unless you attack them.
loading_tip.java_reforged.12: Digging soil or sand with a spade is faster than with your hand!
loading_tip.java_reforged.13: Eating cooked pork chops gives more health than eating raw pork chops.
loading_tip.java_reforged.14: Make some torches to light up areas at night. Monsters will avoid the areas around these torches.
loading_tip.java_reforged.15: Get to destinations faster with a minecart and rail!
loading_tip.java_reforged.16: Plant some saplings and they'll grow into trees.
loading_tip.java_reforged.17: Pigmen won't attack you, unless you attack them.
loading_tip.java_reforged.18: You can change your game spawn point and skip to dawn by sleeping in a bed.
loading_tip.java_reforged.19: Hit those fireballs back at the Ghast!
loading_tip.java_reforged.20: Building a portal will allow you to travel to another dimension - The Nether.
loading_tip.java_reforged.21: Press${java_reforged::controls/BUTTON_RIGHT} to drop the item currently in your hand!
loading_tip.java_reforged.22: Use the right tool for the job!
loading_tip.java_reforged.23: If you can't find any coal for your torches, you can always make charcoal from trees in a furnace.
loading_tip.java_reforged.24: Digging straight down or straight up is not a great idea.
loading_tip.java_reforged.25: Bonemeal (crafted from a Skeleton bone) can be used as a fertilizer, and can make things grow instantly!
loading_tip.java_reforged.26: Creepers explode when they get close to you!
loading_tip.java_reforged.27: Obsidian is created when water hits a lava source block.
loading_tip.java_reforged.28: Lava can take minutes to disappear COMPLETELY when the source block is removed.
loading_tip.java_reforged.29: Cobblestone is resistant to Ghast fireballs, making it useful for guarding portals.
loading_tip.java_reforged.30: Blocks that can be used as a light source will melt snow and ice. This includes torches, glowstone, and Jack-O-Lanterns.
loading_tip.java_reforged.31: Take caution when building structures made of wool in open air, as lightning from thunderstorms can set wool on fire.
loading_tip.java_reforged.32: A single bucket of lava can be used in a furnace to smelt 100 blocks.
loading_tip.java_reforged.33: The instrument played by a note block depends on the material beneath it.
loading_tip.java_reforged.34: Zombies and Skeletons can survive daylight if they are in water.
loading_tip.java_reforged.35: Attacking a wolf will cause any wolves in the immediate vicinity to turn hostile and attack you. This trait is also shared by Zombie Pigmen.
loading_tip.java_reforged.38: Chickens lay an egg every 5 to 10 minutes.
loading_tip.java_reforged.39: Obsidian can only be mined with a diamond pickaxe.
loading_tip.java_reforged.40: Creepers are the easiest obtainable source of gunpowder.
loading_tip.java_reforged.41: Placing two chests side by side will make one large chest.
loading_tip.java_reforged.42: Tame wolves show their health with the position of their tail. Feed them meat to heal them.
loading_tip.java_reforged.43: Cook cactus in a furnace to get green dye.
loading_tip.java_reforged.44: You'll get the latest info on this game from 4JStudios and Kappische on twitter!
loading_tip.java_reforged.45: Don't look an Enderman in the eye!
loading_tip.java_reforged.46: Read the What's New section in the How To Play menus to see the latest update information about the game.
loading_tip.java_reforged.47: Stackable fences are in the game now!
loading_tip.java_reforged.48: minecraftforum has a section dedicated to the Xbox One Edition.
loading_tip.java_reforged.49: Some animals will follow you if you have wheat in your hand.
loading_tip.java_reforged.50: If an animal can't move more than 20 blocks in any direction, it won't despawn.
loading_trivia.java_reforged.2: Notch has over a million followers on twitter!
loading_trivia.java_reforged.3: Not all Swedish people have blonde hair. Some, like Jens from Mojang, even have ginger hair!
loading_trivia.java_reforged.4: We think 4J Studios has removed Herobrine from the Xbox One console game, but we're not too sure.
loading_trivia.java_reforged.5: There will be an update to this game eventually!
loading_trivia.java_reforged.7: Mojang has more awards than staff!
loading_trivia.java_reforged.10: Do not look directly at the bugs.
loading_trivia.java_reforged.11: Creepers were born from a coding bug.
loading_trivia.java_reforged.12: Is it a chicken or is it a duck?
loading_trivia.java_reforged.14: No-one at Mojang has ever seen junkboy's face.
loading_trivia.java_reforged.15: Did you know there's a Minecraft Wiki?
loading_trivia.java_reforged.17: Minecraft: Xbox One Edition broke lots of records!
loading_trivia.java_reforged.18: Minecon 2013 was in Orlando, Florida, USA!
loading_trivia.java_reforged.20: Always assume rumors are false, rather than assuming they're true!
controls.java_reforged.select_binding: Select an action to change its controller binding
controls.java_reforged.capture_hint: Press a button or chord; Delete clears, Escape cancels
controls.java_reforged.calibration.selec: Press any button to select a controller
controls.java_reforged.calibration.press: Press any button on the controller to calibrate
menu.java_reforged.video.split_orientati: Changes how the screen is divided when two local players are connected.
menu.java_reforged.video.optimize_experi: Enables Java Reforged's native terrain multi-draw indirect path.
options.java_reforged.hud_scale.descript: Changes the bottom HUD size between its three levels.
options.java_reforged.split_hud_scale.de: Changes the bottom HUD size used during split screen.
options.java_reforged.interface_mode.des: Compact mode is always used in split screen.
